Fire Destroys Multiple Buses in Vijayawada

A garage fire in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India, destroyed seven private buses. The incident occurred at Auto Nagar, and multiple outlets reported on the massive fire that reduced three buses to ashes. The cause of the fire is not specified.
